content.text:
To make a **federal tax payment online**, use the IRS payments page:

**Best option for most individuals:** **IRS Direct Pay** — pay from a checking/savings account for free, no sign-in required, for balance due, estimated tax, extension payments, etc. ([irs.gov](https://www.irs.gov/payments/direct-pay?utm_source=openai))

Other IRS online options:

- **IRS Online Account** — sign in to view balance/payment history and pay. ([irs.gov](https://www.irs.gov/payments?utm_source=openai))  
- **Debit/credit card or digital wallet** — available through IRS-approved processors; processing fees apply. ([irs.gov](https://www.irs.gov/payments/pay-your-taxes-by-debit-or-credit-card?os=%24420907%2A2&ref=app&utm_source=openai))  
- **Business taxes / federal tax deposits:** use **Business Tax Account** or **EFTPS**. Note: new EFTPS enrollments for individual taxpayers are no longer available; individuals should generally use Online Account or Direct Pay. ([irs.gov](https://www.irs.gov/payments/eftps-the-electronic-federal-tax-payment-system?utm_source=openai))  

**Important tips:**  
- Make sure you’re on an official **irs.gov** page before entering information.  
- Save your confirmation number.  
- Direct Pay payments under $10 million are supported; larger payments require EFTPS or same-day wire. ([irs.gov](https://www.irs.gov/payments/pay-personal-taxes-from-your-bank-account?utm_source=openai))
